items.title: Jason Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had listened to Afro-Cuban music from listening to a lot of Tito Puente

ctx.x: When you say you’re getting into this music, are you listening to it? Or are you actually starting to learn how to perform on any of the instruments?

It’s both. I had listened to Afro-Cuban music from listening to a lot of Tito Puente, but a lot of the details, in terms of what cascara parts and what a songo rhythm is and what – I started to get that. I hadn’t had that before, but now I’m getting that, and how to play with a percussionist. With Casa Samba, I was starting to listen to more Brazilian music while I was practicing with them. So, yes, I was starting to do that, and I was starting to use that even in my own music.
But I’m saying, are you actually playing any of the traditional instruments from those genres?
